title: Alpha
description: +1 Toughness and +1 Injury for all attacks.

title: Fast
description: Moves an extra zone per turn.

title: Elemental
description: All attacks can deal Freezing or Burning.

title: Charging
description: Primary attack also deals +2 Injuries when entering a zone.

title: Suicide
description: Can die and deal 2 Injuries, splash.

title: Webbing
description: Primary attack also deals +1 Stuck, splash.

title: Healing
description: Heal 2 Injuries from one ally in the zone.

title: Restoring
description: Heal 1 Injury from all allies in the zone.

title: Regenerating
description: Heal 2 Injuries at the end of the turn.

title: Encouraging
description: Boost all allies in the zone.
